|2, 3=Phanpyre Shard, none;none, &9Shards, &7While not every creature can/&7become a Pet\, most can be hunted to/&7become &9Shards&7.//&7A &9Shard &7only holds a single/&7creature's power\, called an/&cAttribute&7.
